verdict.rationale: First-party notebooks are a fair question for a managed analytical database, since warehouse vendors can ship them, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes a first-party notebook that mixes SQL and Python with inline results or charts. Compatibility with third-party BI and SQL tools (Grafana, Metabase, Superset), the MCP connection for coding agents, and the observability views are adjacent features or host/third-party capabilities, so they earn no credit.
